HiFi.max_rows_note: the RE, PCR, HiFi and TF sheets each have 12 rows

GGA.max_rows_note: the Anneal, GGA and TF sheets each have 48 rows

template_notes.text: Add the enzymes you need below the last row, one per row, keeping columns A-D (Enzyme, Buffer, Reaction temp., Heat inactivation). Write No in D if the enzyme cannot be heat-inactivated. The RE sheet reads A4:D650. Edits made to an output workbook are lost the next time it is built: copy the template, edit the copy and pass it with --template.
The buffer and its volume (1/10 of the reaction) are for 10×CutSmart. An enzyme that needs another buffer needs this column and the premix below changed.
Volumes and cycling are for KOD One. For another polymerase change the volumes here and the conditions in rows 37-41.
The volumes in rows 46-47 are for FastDigest-type DpnI and its 10×FD buffer. For another DpnI, change them.
Only columns B, C, G, H, I, J, L, M, N, O and P are read by the other sheets. The other columns are free for your own notes.
The reagents and volumes are those of the author's protocol. For other reagents, change the rows below.
The volumes are for the NEBridge kit named here. For another kit, change the reagent rows and volumes.
The volumes are for the NEBridge kit named here. For another kit, change the reagent rows and volumes.
Only columns C, G, H, J, M and N are read by the other sheets. The other columns are free for your own notes.
25 uL of competent cells per sample is the author's value. Change the 25 in the formula in column C, the text in column E and the instruction line in row 12 to match the cells you use.
900 uL of medium per sample is the author's value. Change the 900 in the formula in column C, the text in column E and the instruction line in row 18 to match the medium you use.
